text:
marie (AE): Quick sync — Ada from VertexHealth wants a 2-week POC. They need production-feel latency, cost estimates, and an eval loop. Can we confirm success criteria and integration constraints?

sam (SE): Yep. High level: 1) Latency P95 <= 300ms for chat flows (avg prompt ~120 tokens). 2) Inference cost target <= $0.002/token. 3) Passing security questionnaire (SOC2 + customer KMS). 4) Eval set of ~75 prompts across intents.

ada (Customer): Confirming 2-week timeline. We have 3 core flows: triage chat, summarization of long notes (~2k tokens), and embeddings for search. We'll need streaming for chat.

lia (Security): For security questionnaire: Vertex needs KMS for keys + audit logs. Do we recommend Dedicated or Private for this POC? Also need answers for data residency and retention TTL.

sam (SE): For quick wins use Hosted with workspace-scoped API keys + optional envelope encryption to KMS. If they require customer-managed keys or VPC, recommend Dedicated — can be done later in POC if needed.

tom (Solutions): Integration notes for the devs: use SDK streaming to handle partial tokens; fallback to polling if websocket blocked. Rate-limit plan: start with 40 QPS project-level, 200 burst, per-user soft cap 5 QPS. We'll monitor and iterate.

marie (AE): Pricing question from procurement: can we show a sample estimate for 2wk POC (rough usage)?

sam (SE): Sample conservative estimate: 3 developers testing + 1k chat sessions/day * avg 150 tokens in + 100 tokens out = ~250k tokens/day => ~3.5M tokens over 2 weeks. At $0.002/token => ~$7k. With embedding runs (~200k embedding tokens) add ~$200. Add buffer for retries/rollouts => show $8k range. Note: Dedicated pricing/commits change numbers.

ada (Customer): We can cap traffic during POC; want to avoid surprise costs. How to surface usage live?

stam (billing-bot): billing-bot: You can enable cost alerts in Console -> Usage Alerts. Recommend setting daily spend cap + webhook to their billing email.

lia (Security): On retries & idempotency: require guidance. We need to ensure no duplicate actions for mutating ops.

sam (SE): Client-side: use idempotency keys for any mutation calls and exponential backoff with full jitter. For streaming, buffer partial tokens until commit point. Server-side: enable dedupe by request-id header. Example header: `X-Request-ID: <uuid>`

sam (SE): Quick SDK example (python) for streaming + retry snippet:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="REDACTED")
stream = client.chat.stream(model="redwood-xt-1", input="...", request_id="<uuid>")
for chunk in stream:
    print(chunk.text, end="")
# retry pattern: exponential backoff with jitter, preserve request_id for idempotency
```

tom (Solutions): Success criteria checklist for sign-off (suggested):
- Latency P95 <= 300ms (chat)
- Summarization accuracy: 85% pass on 75-case eval set (human-reviewed)
- Embedding recall@10 >= 0.75 on search benchmark
- No critical security gaps in questionnaire; KMS integration validated
- Telemetry: token-level cost and per-route latency visible in Console

ada (Customer): That matches our expectations. For auth, we will initially use API keys scoped to environment. If POC looks good, we will request Dedicated with customer KMS.

marie (AE): Action items:
- Sam: prepare a 75-prompt eval set + script to run metrics (due in 48h)
- Tom: create a sample SDK repo with streaming + retry examples and a deploy checklist (48h)
- Lia: list exact questionnaire gaps and KMS notes (72h)
- Ada: confirm sample traffic profile and any compliance blockers (48h)

sam (SE): I'll upload the eval harness and a quick k6 traffic profile to the shared repo. Will also add the cost-estimate calc.

ada (Customer): Thanks — I'll confirm traffic numbers by end of day tomorrow.

marie (AE): Great. If anyone sees blockers for Dedicated or legal, flag here. :thumbsup:
